विफल् वि-फल्, cl. 1. P. A. -फलति, -ते,
-फलितुम्, to bear or produce fruit, become fruitful.

विफल वि-फल, अस्, आ, अम्, fruitless, use-
less, ineffectual, unmeaning, vain, idle; (आ), f. a
kind of plant or tree (= केतकी),
—विफल-ता, f.
or विफल-त्व, अम्, n. fruitlessness, unprofitableness.
—विफल-प्रेरण, अस्, आ, अम्, flung in vain.
—विफली-करण, अम्, n. frustrating, foiling, de-
feating; doing anything in vain.
—विफली-कृ, cl.
8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to make fruit-
less or useless, frustrate, foil.
—विफली-कृत, अस्, आ,
अम्, rendered fruitless or ineffectual, frustrated; done
in vain.
—विफलीकृत-यत्न, अस्, आ, अम्, making
fruitless efforts.
—विफली-भविष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ,
becoming or become useless or unprofitable.
—वि-
फलीभविष्णु-ता, f. or विफलीभविष्णु-त्व,
अम्, n. unprofitableness.
—विफली-भू, cl. 1. P.
-भवति, -भवितुम्, to become useless, be unprofit-
able.
—विफली-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become useless.
